Name: Totoro Companion - Adoptable Pet (EN ES ZH)
Author: POCHIMODS
Description:
[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54005/54005-1792435247-1217382529.png[/img][/center]
[b]ENGLISH[/b]
Adopt Totoro at Marnie's for [b]5,000g[/b] (bed: [b]1,000g[/b]). He can follow you, wander around your farm or sleep in his bed. Pet him for a heart!
Right-click the bed to choose his mode; [b]K[/b] to recall/rest. Requires [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] and [b]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/b]. Extract [b]ONE language version[/b] into Mods.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54005/54005-1792435256-1236670763.png[/img][/center]
[b]ESPAÑOL[/b]
Adopta a Totoro en Marnie por [b]5.000 monedas[/b] (cama: [b]1.000[/b]). Puede seguirte, deambular por la granja o dormir en su cama. ¡Acarícialo para ver un corazón!
Clic derecho en la cama para elegir; [b]K[/b] para llamarlo o descansar. Necesita [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] y [b]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/b]. Descomprime [b]UNA versión de idioma[/b] en Mods.

[center][img]https://staticdelivery.nexusmods.com/mods/1303/images/54005/54005-1792435256-1947707913.png[/img][/center]
[b]简体中文[/b]
在玛妮处花费 [b]5,000 金[/b]领养龙猫，小床售价 [b]1,000 金[/b]。它会跟随你、在农场闲逛，或在床上睡觉。抚摸它就会出现爱心！
右键点击小床选择模式；按 [b]K[/b] 叫它回来或让它休息。需要 [b]Stardew Valley 1.6.15+[/b] 和 [b]SMAPI 4.5.2+[/b]。只选[b]一个语言版本[/b]，解压到 Mods。
